height_normalization: PARI ellheightmatrix (PARI >= 2.7 normalization), equal to the BSD regulator convention of Cremona/Sage/LMFDB; check: Reg(389a1) = 0.152460177943143751624...

precision_policy.serialization: 45 significant decimal digits via PARI strprintf; PARI real zeros kept with exponent (e.g. 0.E-57)

cypari2_precision_finding: In cypari2 2.2.9, method calls such as pari.ellheightmatrix(E,P) did NOT follow pari.set_real_precision_bits() (they stayed at 192 bits after the first call). All precision-dependent calls therefore pass precision=bits explicitly; effective precision is read back with bitprecision() and recorded per curve as the minimum over Gram entries and derived reals. PARI returns one extra guard word in some cases (requested 192 -> effective 192 or 256; requested 256 -> 256 or 320).
